If you are passionate about unlocking potential, skilled at building trusted relationships, and energised by the complexity of a world-class professional services environment, this role offers real breadth, purpose, and impact.
About the Role
Reporting to the Head of HR - UK&I, the Career Advisor acts as a dedicated and confidential resource for Associates navigating every stage of their careers at Freshfields. You will work collaboratively across the firm — partnering with Practice Group Leaders, HR Business Partners, the Diversity & Inclusion team, and Marketing and Business Development colleagues — to deliver against the firm's broader Talent Development strategy. You will also engage closely with Freshfields' global career development and coaching community, ensuring UK&I initiatives are aligned with and contribute to firmwide frameworks.
This is a role with genuine scope: from one-to-one coaching relationships to programme design, from data-driven insight to strategic stakeholder influence.
What You'll Do
Coaching and individual career support
You will provide high-quality, confidential career coaching to Associates on a wide range of topics — from practice integration and relationship building to performance improvement, promotion readiness, and long-term career planning. Engagements may range from targeted, short-term interventions to sustained advisory relationships, and you will support Associates through key transitions including progression to Senior Associate or Counsel, lateral moves, secondments, and return-to-work following parental or other leave.
Programme design and facilitation
You will design and deliver career development programmes and workshops that complement individual coaching and align with the firm's global learning and development offering. You will also oversee the UK mentoring programme, fostering effective mentor-mentee relationships and helping Associates develop, maintain, and review meaningful individual development plans.
Collaboration and stakeholder partnership
Working closely with HR Business Partners and Resource Managers, you will translate performance feedback into clear, actionable development plans and help Associates track progress against firmwide career frameworks. You will maintain strong relationships with partners, Marketing and Business Development, and the alumni network to surface external development opportunities, strategic secondments, and client-facing experiences. You will also partner with external coaching providers — in areas such as neurodiversity support, early careers coaching, and outplacement — ensuring quality and value.
Diversity, inclusion, and integration
You will work alongside the Diversity & Inclusion team to support the development and retention of a diverse Associate population and leadership pipeline, and will play an active role in embedding lateral hires quickly and effectively into the firm.
Insight and continuous improvement
You will use analytics and reporting to monitor the impact of coaching interventions, identify demographic and retention trends, and translate insight into engaging dashboards that demonstrate return on investment. Your observations will also feed into the broader Learning and Development agenda, helping to strengthen talent initiatives across the UK.
What We're Looking For
You will bring significant experience in professional development, coaching, or a career advisory capacity — ideally within a law firm or professional services environment — along with a genuine understanding of the legal profession and the career landscape within it. Specifically, we are looking for:
•
A bachelor's degree, and a coaching certification or equivalent (strongly preferred)
•
Demonstrable experience in a professional development, coaching, or career advisory role within a law firm, professional services firm, or academic institution; law firm practice experience is a strong advantage
•
Familiarity with legal career frameworks and the broader legal market
•
Exceptional judgement and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential information
•
The interpersonal skills and credibility to build trusted relationships across practice groups, seniority levels, and geographies — both in person and remotely
•
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt your style for diverse stakeholders
•
Strong analytical and organisational capability, with the confidence to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed environment
•
Proficiency in MS Office and HR systems, with the aptitude to learn new platforms quickly
Inclusion
Freshfields is an equal opportunities employer and all applications received by the firm will be considered on the basis of merit alone. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals regardless of background. All offers of employment will be conditional on the candidate having or securing the right to work in the UK and providing the firm with evidence of that right (as required by the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006) prior to employment commencing.

​​About Us
Airbus is Europe’s number one Defence and Space enterprise, so what better way to start your Craft Apprenticeship than with an industry leader.
Being a Panels Manufacturing Technician Craft Apprentice at Airbus means you will get to develop Mechanical skills within our programme. You will be immersed in a stimulating Manufacturing environment.
As a Panels Manufacturing Technician Craft Apprentice, you'll gain hands-on experience in a highly specialized and stimulating manufacturing environment. You'll develop essential mechanical skills while working on large, complex Satellite Panels that are then built into a Satellite Structure. This is your chance to contribute to missions that will explore our solar system, protect our planet, and provide vital communication services.
This role is for someone who wants to turn their passion for practical skills into a career that is literally out of this world! You will be immersed in a supportive team of experts who will mentor you as you build components that will endure the harsh realities of space.
What you will be doing
Year 1: You will study towards a Level 2 Engineering Operative ST0537 on the materials and processing pathway, gaining both academic knowledge and practical experience.
Year 2: During the Apprenticeship you will have a unique opportunity to experience different Production Areas of the business which will provide you with a comprehensive understanding of how a Satellite is manufactured at Airbus Defence & Space. This includes working in small teams or on a one-to-one basis to manufacture Spacecraft Panels, Mirror Bonding and Treatments using the latest approved processes and advanced production techniques for Satellite manufacture.
Your key activities & responsibilities will be:
Panel Assembly
• Use of various different adhesives
• Use of hand measuring tools to meet tight tolerances
• Installation of various panel features (potting inserts, riveting, edge taping)
• Following process and tolerances to drawings on 3DX
Final Assembly
• Installation of panel features including Ty-bases, MLI (multi-layer insulated blankets) studs, connector brackets & cleats and brackets using laser technology
• Heat pipe installation to extremely tight tolerances as low as 0.15mm
Mirror bonding
• Use of silicone adhesive to install SSM (second surface mirrors) to various types of panels and spacecraft features.
• Cutting mirrors with diamond tip pens to extreme accuracy
Treatments
• Surface finish measurements such as friction and paint thickness
• Application of surface finishes including aerospace approved primers and paints
• Grit blasting
• Conversion coatings and protective finishes
• Masking of hardware in preparation for spraying
During the 2nd year of the apprenticeship, you will attend a week of Team Building Activities and Exercises at one of the Outward-Bound UK Sites. Split up into teams consisting of Apprentices of all levels from various Airbus Defence and Space sites, you will work as a team to complete daily activities such as Rock Climbing, Hiking, Abseiling, Canoeing and more
Year 3: You will be fully on-site, fine tuning your hand skills against the business skills matrix.
Requirements
• Funding Eligibility: Applicants must be aged 16–21* and cannot hold a Level 2 or higher qualification (e.g., NVQ, BTEC, HND, or Degree) in Engineering, Aerospace, or related technical fields. For more information, please consult Foundation Apprenticeships Criteria*
• Education: No strict formal entry requirements, though a Grade 3 (or equivalent) in GCSE Maths and English is desirable.
• Skills & Attributes: Strong communication, reliability, excellent work ethic, a can-do attitude, and the ability to follow technical instructions and work well independently or in a team.
• No prior experience required—full on-the-job training will be provided.

What is it about Airbus that makes you excited to start a career with us? Is it our aircraft, innovation, global impact, or something else? Let us know what interests you about our work and why we stand out to you.

Why do you want to learn by doing? We’d love to hear what draws you to practical, skills-based learning.

•
• DIY projects
• Building and fixing things
• Doing make-up or beauty work
• Tinkering and Tech Projects
• Building models
• Baking or cooking
• Others
Show Us What You've Built!
We love seeing what you are passionate about. If you've worked on any hands-on projects—whether it's building, baking, fixing something —we'd be thrilled to see it!
Feel free to attach photos, documents, or a short video showcasing a project you're proud of. This isn't a requirement, but it’s a fantastic way to give us a glimpse of your practical skills. We can't wait to see your work!
Important Information:
Joint-Venture: This Job Request will be allocated to the projected Joint-Venture scope towards a leading European player in space.

SECURITY CLEARANCE: You will be subject to a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) check. You may also need to gain UK SC-level Security Clearance or Export Control, depending on the role.

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. Are you ready to make your impact?
About The Role
We work with corporations, governments and law firms to meet legal, regulatory and investigative demands by leveraging our skills to enable our clients to more confidently govern, secure, find, analyse and rapidly understand their data in the context of compliance and risk.
We are looking for dedicated and experienced professionals to join our growing Digital Forensics & Investigations team in London. FTI Consulting advises clients in confidential data disputes, regulatory investigations, litigations and all types of evidence-driven technology challenges, often in alignment with regulator expectations and disclosure requirements. This role is based in our London team as part of our EMEA-wide and global network of professionals.
What You’ll Do
As a Senior Director within FTI’s Digital Forensics & Investigations practice, you will take a leading role in shaping and delivering complex data-driven client engagements, acting as a trusted advisor and expert to clients and external counsel. You will combine deep technical expertise with sound strategic judgement to deliver clarity in challenging, high-stakes matters.
Your responsibilities will include:
•
Advising clients and law firms in a range of data-driven engagements within the framework of legal action or internal investigations.
•
Leading client relationships, ensuring projects are delivered to the highest technical and ethical standards.
•
Supporting regulatory investigations by interpreting and meeting the expectations of UK and international authorities.
•
Acting as an expert witness — drafting and peer reviewing formal statements, preparing expert reports and providing oral evidence in court or arbitration.
•
Leading complex digital forensic investigations across a broad range of devices, data systems and cloud environments.
•
Directing mobile device forensic analysis, including advanced extraction, decryption, and interpretation of app and messaging data.
•
Conducting forensic imaging, recovery and analysis in line with industry best practice.
•
Developing methodologies for cloud and hybrid ecosystems, including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS, Azure, and other SaaS or collaboration platforms.
•
Integrating automation, analytics, and AI-assisted techniques to enhance accuracy, speed and defensibility.
•
Mentoring and supporting junior team members, fostering a culture of excellence, curiosity and integrity.
•
Collaborating across FTI’s EMEA and global networks to share knowledge, develop tools and contribute to cross-disciplinary innovation.
•
Travelling as required to perform work at client premises in the UK and internationally, sometimes at short notice.
How You’ll Grow
We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.
As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.
What You Will Need to Succeed
•
Experience conducting digital forensic investigations within consulting, law enforcement or corporate environments.
•
Drafting and peer review of digital forensics reports and expert reports for legal proceedings.
•
Experience of regulatory investigations, with a sound understanding of regulator expectations, evidential requirements and disclosure processes.
•
Expertise in mobile device forensics, including logical and physical extractions, artefact interpretation, and encrypted data handling.
•
Strong knowledge of forensic tools and methodologies (e.g. EnCase, X-Ways, Nuix, Magnet AXIOM, Cellebrite, Oxygen, FTK).
•
Ability to present technical findings clearly to legal and non-technical stakeholders.
•
Experience leading forensic collections both on-site and remotely across the UK and internationally.
•
High degree of professionalism, discretion, and resilience in high-pressure environments.
Basic Qualifications
•
Degree or postgraduate qualification in Computer Science, Digital Forensics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Preferred Qualifications
•
Familiarity with cloud and SaaS forensics, including collection and analysis of collaboration and audit artefacts.
•
Competence with scripting or automation languages (e.g. PowerShell, Python, SQL) for forensic workflow optimisation.
•
Exposure to AI and machine learning applications in forensic and eDiscovery contexts (e.g. triage, clustering, anomaly detection, generative summarisation).
•
Experience integrating forensic outputs within wider eDiscovery, incident response or regulatory frameworks.
•
Professional certifications such as EnCE, GASF, GCFA, CISSP, RCA, or equivalent.

Job Description
Principal Embedded Software Engineer (C)
Up to £70,000 depending on experience
About the Role
We have opportunities for ambitious Embedded Software Engineers at Principal level to join our multidisciplinary engineering team at the forefront of additive manufacturing technology.
Our embedded software platforms are central to the control, sensing, communication, monitoring and real-time processing capabilities of our next-generation products. Working within Research & Development, you will contribute to the full product lifecycle, from concept and architecture through verification, release to production, and long-term support.
These are hands-on engineering roles, combining embedded software development, debugging and verification with close collaboration across electronics, FPGA, systems, algorithms and mechanical engineering teams. Depending on experience and grade, you will also provide technical leadership, influence engineering strategy, and mentor developing engineers.
The software frequently interacts with microcontrollers, FPGAs, sensors, communication networks and analogue electronics. As such, a strong appreciation of system-level design and hardware/software interaction is essential.
Key Responsibilities
Embedded Software Development
•
Develop embedded software architectures and applications from concept through to production release.
•
Design, implement and maintain high-quality C software with a focus on performance, reliability, maintainability and portability.
•
Develop low-level drivers, middleware and application-layer software for embedded systems.
•
Implement communication interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, Ethernet and industrial communication protocols.
•
Optimise software for real-time performance, memory usage and deterministic behaviour.
•
Support product sustainment, issue investigation and software improvements throughout the product lifecycle.
•
Develop reusable software frameworks and libraries for use across multiple projects and product generations.
Verification & Validation
•
Develop robust software verification strategies covering unit, integration and system-level testing.
•
Create automated test frameworks and regression test suites.
•
Define verification plans, acceptance criteria and coverage objectives.
•
Support hardware-in-the-loop, system integration and product validation activities.
•
Drive continuous improvement in automated testing, continuous integration and software quality metrics.
•
Investigate and resolve complex software and system-level defects.
Systems & Product Development
•
Capture, analyse and refine requirements, ensuring clear traceability from customer and system requirements through to implementation and verification.
•
Work closely with systems, electronics, FPGA, algorithms and test engineers to deliver integrated solutions.
•
Evaluate and implement control, signal processing and embedded algorithms on target hardware platforms.
•
Contribute to safety, reliability and compliance activities, including design assurance and audit-ready engineering evidence.
•
Produce and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including software architecture specifications, interface definitions, design descriptions and verification reports.
Strategic & Architectural Leadership
•
Define software architecture roadmaps and technical direction across multiple products and programmes.
•
Assess and introduce new technologies, tools, frameworks and development methodologies.
•
Act as a recognised subject matter expert for embedded software and real-time control systems.
•
Influence system-level architecture decisions and long-term technology strategy.
Essential Requirements
•
Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics or a related discipline.
•
Strong commercial experience developing embedded software using C.
•
Solid understanding of embedded software principles, including:
•
Real-time and deterministic systems
•
DMA and Interrupt-driven architectures
•
Memory management
•
State machines
•
Communications protocols
•
Multi-threaded and event-driven systems
•
Experience developing software for microcontroller-based systems.
•
Experience debugging software on target hardware using modern debugging tools.
•
Understanding of software development lifecycles, version control and testing methodologies.
•
Ability to communicate effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team
•
Extensive experience leading the architecture and development of complex embedded products.
•
Recognised expertise in embedded software, real-time systems and hardware/software integration.
•
Track record of influencing engineering strategy and technology direction.
•
Strong capability in technical leadership across multiple programmes and engineering disciplines.
•
Experience defining engineering processes, software standards and verification methodologies.
Desirable Requirements
•
Experience with ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers and associated development environments.
•
Knowledge of C++, Python or scripting languages used for automation and testing.
•
Experience implementing industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, Modbus, CANopen or IO-Link.
•
Experience with Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD workflows.
•
Familiarity with unit testing frameworks and static analysis tools.
•
Understanding of control systems, signal processing and numerical algorithms.
•
Knowledge of FPGA-based systems and hardware/software partitioning.
•
Experience of high-speed digital electronics, EMC and mixed-signal systems.
•
Experience working within regulated or safety-conscious product development environments.
Person Specification
You are a passionate and capable engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and delivering robust, high-quality products.
You combine strong embedded software expertise with a systems-level mindset and are comfortable working across disciplinary boundaries. You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively and take ownership of technical outcomes.
At Principal level, you are a recognised technical authority who influences product architecture, engineering strategy and organisational capability while continuing to engage with hands-on engineering challenges.
You are naturally curious, pragmatic and quality-focused, with a strong appreciation of how embedded software interacts with electronics, FPGA technology, mechanical systems and user requirements to create reliable, high-performance products.

When you join Renishaw, we're committing to your future career. That's because we believe in developing our people's skills and promoting them internally. We’ll help you succeed
Our clients trust us because of the quality of our advice.  That quality grows from a thorough understanding of their business, and that understanding comes from working closely with clients and building long-lasting relationships.

•
An in depth, up to date, knowledge of taxation with specialist knowledge and the ability to deal with complex tax issues.
•
Experience of dealing with all matters relating to the management of a portfolio of clients.
•
Experience of managing a portfolio of clients including control of client take on and engagement, billings, and identification of opportunities to improve recoveries, together with cash collection.
•
Ability to provide Tax compliance and advisory services to a wide range of clients using resource from a shared service team or via technology tools.
•
An understanding of potential risks to the Firm in relation to the Firm’s quality control procedures
•
Experience of leading complex projects.
•
Educated to degree level and/or CTA and/or ACA qualified or equivalent

We can provide the best support for our clients and people when we’re working side by side.  Our agile working framework helps us stay connected, bringing teams together where and when it counts so they can share ideas and help one another.  At BDO, you’ll always have access to the people and resources you need to do your best work.

We’re looking forward to the future
At BDO, we help entrepreneurial businesses to succeed, fuelling the UK economy. Our success is powered by our people, which is why we’re always finding new ways to invest in you. Across the UK thousands of unique minds continue to come together to help companies we work with to achieve their ambitions
We’ve got a clear purpose, and we’re confident in our future, because we’re adapting and evolving to build on our strengths, ensuring we continue to find the right combination of global reach, integrity and expertise. Working as part of a fully functioning engineering team, the Full Stack AI Engineer contributes across the delivery lifecycle, from understanding the problem and shaping the solution through development, deployment, and iteration.
Success in this role means writing high-quality code, learning quickly, contributing effectively within a team, and developing the judgment to build AI-enabled software that creates measurable value for clients and the business.

The role is intended for engineers early in their careers. Success is not measured by years of experience or by knowledge of a particular AI framework. It is measured by strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility, quality of thinking, and the ability to contribute working code to AI-enabled solutions.

Head of Global Labelling
The Role
CSL Seqirus' influenza vaccine portfolio reaches millions of people every year, and every one of those products depends on labelling that's scientifically sound, regulatory compliant, and is clear and informative for the end-user. This role leads the function responsible for labelling globally — with a seat on the regulatory leadership team and as Chair of the Global Labelling Committee.
As Head of Global Labelling, you'll shape the strategic direction of labelling for Seqirus’ worldwide portfolio, reporting to the VP Regulatory Affairs & Pharmacovigilance. It's the point where clinical data, regulatory requirement, and commercial reality converge to ultimately define how a product is understood and used.
What You'll Be Responsible For
You'll lead a global team of established labelling professionals, coaching them in strategic thinking and the leadership behaviours Seqirus expects of its people  — while owning the end-to-end labelling review and approval process and driving its continuous improvement.
You'll set global labelling strategy, balancing business need against the core obligation of getting benefit/risk information right for the people relying on it, and you'll ensure the underlying processes deliver accurate, timely labelling information that supports the safe and effective use of Seqirus’ products, importantly, including the regulatory requirements around timely safety-related updates.
Separately, you'll ensure efficient labelling operations support for the time-critical annual strain updates that seasonal influenza vaccines require.
Beyond the team, you'll provide labelling perspective to governance bodies, represent Seqirus' position in external regulatory forums, and provide labelling subject matter expertise for internal and external labelling-related audits. You'll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders including Global Safety, Clinical Development, Commercial and Supply Chain to ensure effective and timely labelling deliverables meet business needs across every region Seqirus operates in.
Experience Required
• Significant experience in Global Regulatory Affairs, with a strong focus on product labelling and management of core labelling documentation.
• Proven leadership of global, multi-country teams, including coaching and developing talent.
• Track record owning and continuously improving a regulated process end-to-end.
• Experience representing a company's positions to governance bodies or external regulators.
• Working familiarity with labelling-related audits and the regulatory frameworks that govern labelling compliance.
• Director-level experience (or equivalent) in a global pharma or biotech organization.
About CSL Seqirus
CSL Seqirus is part of CSL. As one of the largest influenza vaccine providers in the world, CSL Seqirus is a major contributor to the prevention of influenza globally and a transcontinental partner in pandemic preparedness. With state-of-the-art production facilities in the U.S., the U.K. and Australia, CSL Seqirus utilizes egg, cell and adjuvant technologies to offer a broad portfolio of differentiated influenza vaccines in more than 20 countries around the world.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/.
Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL.
You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

You'll receive a base salary of £38,993, alongside uncapped earning potential and a variety of opportunities to boost your overall earnings, including:
• On-call payment: Receive £330 for each on-call week, based on an average rota of one week in five. (OTE of £42,293 just with the base salary and conducting mandatory on call requirements)
• Industry-leading installation bonus: Benefit from an uncapped installation bonus of £25 per meter or £50 per dual installation once you have completed a minimum of four installations in a day, with additional work opportunities available to further enhance your earnings.
• London weighting: Receive an additional £2,000 annual allowance if you live within the M25.
• Enhanced overtime: Enhanced overtime rates for Sunday working.
Alongside your salary and uncapped earning potential, you will receive 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays, a healthcare scheme, mental wellbeing support, access to 24/7 GP and counselling services, and a generous pension scheme. You will also receive one paid volunteering day each year and have opportunities to win tickets to events at Utilita-sponsored arenas and football matches.
Why work at Utilita?
A schedule that supports your work-life balance.
We understand that a great Smart Meter Engineer role is not just about salary. It is also about having a structured working day and being able to plan your life accordingly.
You will be scheduled an average of 4 jobs per day, with an average travel time to jobs of approximately 35 minutes between appointments.
We aim to schedule your work several weeks in advance, giving you greater visibility of your schedule. This helps you plan life outside work while still giving you the opportunity to take on additional work when it suits you.
First-class training and support.
Your journey will begin at our award-winning training academy in Warrington, where you will receive a comprehensive induction.

A team that keeps you connected.
We understand that working in the field can sometimes feel isolating, which is why creating a connected and supportive environment is so important to us.
Through regular manager check-ins, access to technical experts, collaborative colleague networks and ongoing communication, you'll always have the support you need and someone to turn to throughout your working day.
What you will be doing.
As a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer, you will represent Utilita in customers’ homes, installing smart meters safely and professionally across domestic properties.

• Smart Metering qualifications, including CCN1 or CMA1 and MET1, or equivalent.

Who are Utilita?
Founded in 2003, Utilita Energy was created to challenge the Big Six energy suppliers by offering a fair and flexible service that is good for both the pocket and the planet.
As the first supplier to install a Smart Meter back in 2005 and kick-start Britain’s smart meter revolution, we continue to invest in smart technology and look for new ways to improve our services through innovation.
We are also committed to sustainability, with an ambition to become a Net Zero business by 2030. We believe everyone can make a meaningful impact through small, positive changes.
Our values are simple but powerful:
Fairness. Smart. Sustainability.
Our employees and customers come from all walks of life. We are committed to championing diversity, creating an inclusive culture and providing an environment where you can be your authentic self.
Utilita is part of the Luxion group which comprises Luxion Group Ltd, Utilita Energy Ltd, Luxion Sales Ltd, Utilita Field Services Ltd, Procode Technology Ltd and Canary Care Global Ltd.

Product Governance Apprenticeship
Help Review and Shape Insurance Products that Work for Our Customers
Ready to earn, learn and launch your career? This is more than your first job. You’ll gain real experience, work towards a recognised qualification and build skills that will shape your future.
Insurance products can have a big impact on people's lives. Our Product Governance team reviews products throughout their life cycle, from launch to future changes or withdrawal, to check they meet customers' needs and continue to provide fair value.
This is a strategic role where you'll look at the bigger picture, use evidence to understand how products are performing and help suggest how they should be improved. You'll use data such as claims, customer feedback and complaints to spot risks and identify where products could be improved. You'll also learn how Howden meets Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) requirements and delivers good outcomes for customers.
You’ll join Howden on a permanent role and complete an 18-month development programme designed to develop your technical knowledge, professional skills and confidence to kick start your career.
What you’ll be doing?
You will begin with a structured induction before joining our Product Governance team, where you will work alongside experienced colleagues and gradually take on more responsibility.
During the programme, you'll:
• Build your knowledge of insurance products and the regulations Howden must follow.
• Learn how insurance products move through their life cycle, from initial design and launch to review, improvement or withdrawal.
• Support regular reviews to check that products meet the needs of their intended customers and continue to offer fair value.
• Review information including claims data, customer survey results, satisfaction measures and complaints.
• Help compare product performance and customer outcomes against relevant regulatory expectations.
• Collaborate and gain exposure to colleagues across broking, claims, insurers, risk, compliance and other areas of the business.
Who are we looking for?
No insurance experience is needed; we’ll teach you everything you need to know!
You'll be:
• Curious, willing to ask questions and keen to understand how insurance products work and affect customers.
• Comfortable working with numbers, data and spreadsheets. You do not need advanced Excel skills, as you will be trained in this area.
• Analytical and logical, with an interest in analysing various sources of information and spotting patterns.
• Confident building relationships and working with people from different teams.
• Organised and able to manage several responsibilities while following clear processes.
• Adaptable and able to change focus when priorities shift.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.
To be eligible for our apprenticeship, you must:
• Have the full and unrestricted right to work in the UK.
• Have lived permanently in the UK for the last 3 years.
• Have achieved a grade C/4 in GCSE English and Maths.
• Not already hold a qualification that significantly overlaps with the content of this apprenticeship.
Application process
Our application process is designed to help you show your potential, not to test what you already know!
• Online application form – no CV required: We believe you're more than just a document, so we won’t ask you to submit a CV. Please upload a blank document on the application form.
• Online gamified assessment: We’ve created games that will help us understand your natural strengths and how you approach different situations. There are no right or wrong answers. You can complete this stage on your phone or laptop, whichever suits you best!
• Pre-recorded video interview: You will record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting.
• Assessment centre: Our final stage is an in-person assessment centre at one of our offices. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture. We'll cover all your travel costs for this day, because where you are now, shouldn’t hold back your future!

At Howden, people are at the heart of everything we do. As an employee-owned business, we believe success is built through collaboration, learning and supporting one another. You'll gain exposure to an exciting global industry, receive structured development throughout the summer and build relationships that could shape your future career.
You'll also benefit from:
• £23,000 and a generous pension scheme.
• Completing fully funded professional qualifications relevant for your role.
• Structured learning and development through our 18-month apprenticeship development programme.
• 25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays.
Ready to apply?

You can also follow our TikTok accounts, @earlycareersjo and @millieinsurancecareers, for behind-the-scenes insights into life at Howden, career advice, and application tips from our Early Careers team.

Job Title

Job Description
So, who are we?
IG is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.

Acting as its primary compliance advisory contact, the role works closely with various stakeholders including Risk, Finance, Operations and Legal and partners day-to-day with the Prime desk.
Your role in the Teams Success:
Reporting to the Head of Compliance Advisory, you will provide expert compliance advice, guidance and challenge to institutional business teams, ensuring regulatory standards are met, while balancing commercial objectives and risk appetite. What You'll Do:
• Act as the primary compliance advisory contact for the Prime team, providing timely, practical, and risk-proportionate regulatory advice on institutional business activities.
• Review and approve financial promotions relating to Prime and institutional products, ensuring content is fair, clear, and not misleading and meets regulatory standards.
• Provide compliance input into new product or platform development and change initiatives affecting the Prime business, identifying regulatory requirements and risks early and shaping mitigations into design.
• Advise on the regulatory treatment of institutional and professional client activity, including client categorisation, onboarding, and conduct-of-business requirements.

• Acts with integrity and consistently demonstrates high professional and ethical standards.
• Delivers high-quality work with energy, accountability, and a strong sense of urgency.
• Commercial and solutions-focused, enabling growth while maintaining strong compliance and client protection.
• Committed to continuous improvement in controls and ways of working.
• Communicates clearly and manages stakeholders effectively.
• Collaborates constructively while providing confident and effective challenge.
• Comfortable working from IG’s London office a minimum of three days per week.
The Perks
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Location: Bristol, UK
Hybrid: Office: Monday – Thursday
Our Team
Fancy a career at the sharp end of how the world actually connects? Join an ambitious and collaborative engineering team at the cutting edge of global data communications.
Based in Bristol, we work closely with a world-renowned design group to develop advanced semiconductor solutions that power the digital infrastructure of tomorrow.
Our culture is open, inclusive, and driven by innovation — and as a graduate joining us, you won't be making the coffee - You'll be in the lab, hands-on, from week one.
Job Summary
Ready to turn your degree into a career that actually matters?
As a Graduate High-Speed Validation Engineer, you'll be trained up to test and validate next-generation semiconductor devices that are shaping the future of global connectivity — the chips inside the networks that move the world's data.
No two days will look the same: one week you might be in new product design meetings helping shape how a device gets tested, the next you'll be in the lab taking real measurements on components running at 10Gbit/s and beyond.
You'll learn from experienced engineers who genuinely want to see you grow, get hands-on with industry-leading test equipment, and pick up skills — from Python/LabVIEW automation to high-speed signal integrity — that will set you up for a serious engineering career.
This is your launchpad. Bring the curiosity and work ethic; we'll bring the mentorship, the kit, and the opportunity.
Responsibilities
• Support new product design meetings and help develop test approaches for evaluating new products
• Assist in building validation solutions for new products — covering software, hardware, and documentation
• Help identify the right bench-top test equipment for validating new products
• Learn to build test automation software using Python or LabVIEW
• Work closely with designers, product, test, and applications engineers as part of a genuinely collaborative team
• Take part in validation review meetings and contribute your findings
• Help create clear, accurate validation reports
• Get hands-on testing high-speed optical components, ICs, and modules
• Take high-speed lab measurements on products operating at data rates of 10Gbit/s and above
• Build your knowledge of high-speed signal integrity, including exposure to schematic entry/layout using Altium PCB tools
Minimum Qualifications
• BSc/MSc in Electrical/Electronic Engineering (EE/ECE) or a closely related discipline
• 0–2 years' relevant experience — this role is designed for recent graduates ready to build their career in high-speed validation
• A genuine curiosity for electronics, test, and measurement, and a willingness to learn fast
• Able to stay focused and positive in a fast-paced, dynamic R&D environment
• A natural team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and asking questions
• Good interpersonal and communication skills
• Strong self-motivation — comfortable picking up new tools and techniques independently
• An analytical mindset, attention to detail, and a creative approach to problem-solving
Career Growth Philosophy
At Semtech, we believe that innovation starts with people — and that includes the people just starting out.
That's why we're committed to empowering your professional development through mentorship, structured learning, and a collaborative, idea-rich environment from day one.
Our pay-for-performance culture rewards initiative and celebrates meaningful contributions, no matter how early in your career you are.
Join us, and be part of a team that's building the future of connectivity — together.

This role sits within the Scientific Data and Publications function in GSK’s Research & Development (R&D) division.  Access to external scientific information (published literature, patent and competitive intelligence, chemistry and biology databases, and commercial data sources) is foundational to GSK’s ability to discover and develop transformative medicines.  Ensuring R&D has the right content, at the right cost, with the right governance, directly accelerates scientific decision-making.
Job-purpose:
The Associate Director (Scientific Data and Publications) is a key role within the Research Operations & Externalization (ROX) organisation, accountable for maintaining GSK R&D’s enterprise portfolio of external scientific content and data licenses.
This position manages the portfolio, including its budget, forecasting and cost controls, and for retiring under-used sources so the portfolio stays focused on the content that delivers value for GSK.   This position also manages vendor relationships and commercial terms to ensure licensed content is accessible, supported, compliantly used, and demonstrably delivers return on investment for the scientists who depend on it.  The role works closely with the associated Director to shape strategic direction, serving as a strategic advisor and thought-partner to contribute recommendations and expert perspective.
You will serve as a key connector across scientific, procurement, legal, copyright, digital and technology functions, and as the senior interface to major information providers.  You will maintain the governance, controls and user guidance that keep GSK’s use of published information copyright-compliant.  You will work closely with colleagues across the company (including licensing, copyright, information specialist and technology colleagues) to deliver service, compliance and support, as well as contribute to the future-state operating model for scientific publications and external data.  You will also position the portfolio to be exploited by rapidly evolving AI and text-mining capabilities, staying close to emerging AI use cases (across R&D) to anticipate future licensing needs and work with digital and technology teams and vendors to make licensed content AI-ready.
Please Note - Location:  The successful applicant can be based at Stevenage (UK) or Upper Providence (USA).  If the successful applicant is based at Stevenage site:  This role will temporarily be based at Stevenage.  However, the Company plans to relocate its offices to Cambridge, UK. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.  Find out more - our approach to R&D:  https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/innovation/

• Proficiency with a range of digital tools (including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, SharePoint, Teams) and experience leveraging AI or digital technologies to improve efficiency or insights.
• Working knowledge of copyright and licensing governance, and an understanding of text mining, analytics and content usage (specifically relating to use rights and terms of contracts).

With over 42,000 customers worldwide, we analyze more than 18 billion security events daily to stop attacks before they cause harm. As pioneers in Human Risk Management, we combine advanced threat detection, awareness training, and insider risk management into a platform that addresses the human element of cybersecurity – because people are both an organization’s greatest asset and its most significant security vulnerability.
About the role
Are you passionate about stopping bad things from happening to good organizations? At Mimecast, we do just that – and in Customer Value Management, we go further, making sure every customer realizes real, measurable value from what they’ve invested in.
We are looking for a driven and customer-centric Customer Value Manager who is passionate about building strong relationships and delivering measurable security outcomes. In this role you are the trusted technical advisor for a portfolio of mid-market accounts. You work within a three-person account pod – alongside an Account Manager and a Renewals Manager – where your lane is clear: drive product adoption and utilization, own technical and value health, and turn what our platform can do into the outcomes your customers care about.
The through-line of the role: adoption drives outcomes, and outcomes create value.
What You’ll Do:
Drive value through adoption & utilization
• Own platform adoption and drive measurable utilization across your portfolio, so that capability translates into protection and the outcomes each customer invested in.
• Lead product adoption/activation, configuration health and platform optimization across Mimecast’s full product portfolio – including Email Threat Protection, Human Risk Management (HRM), Incydr (Code42) and DMARC Analyzer.
• Advance each customer’s Human Risk Management maturity by mapping behavior and attack-exposure data to Mimecast’s HRM framework and recommending targeted awareness-training outcomes.
• Own the technical and value health score for each account – tracking adoption depth, feature utilization, deployment completeness and customer satisfaction signals.
Prove and communicate value
• Quantify and package proof-of-value – adoption metrics, threat-block summaries, HRM progression and deployment health – for executive-level consumption, including pre-meeting technical briefings ahead of Account Manager executive engagements.
• Deliver Business Reviews – including on-site EBRs and executive meetings – in partnership with the Account Manager: own the value and technical narrative and the adoption data while the Account Manager leads the executive conversation and you own all follow-up and action-item accountability.
Be a customer-centric, trusted advisor
• Build strong external partnerships across your customer base, grounded in a genuine understanding of each customer’s environment, objectives, risks, and definition of success.
• Translate complex security architecture into business-level value conversations for executive audiences without losing credibility with technical counterparts.
• Represent the voice of the customer internally – capturing and routing feedback to Product Management.
Protect and grow the account, with your pod
• Proactively mitigate churn risk: identify at-risk accounts 90+ days before renewal, lead the technical recovery plan with your Account Manager, and maintain documented records of at-risk accounts and competitive threats for pod visibility and renewal positioning.
• Identify expansion signals – unused modules, seat growth, HRM maturity readiness, compliance gaps – and hand them to the Account Manager with supporting technical context and timing rationale.
• Own technical escalation transparency across your portfolio: represent the customer’s technical context internally, coordinate with Support Engineering on critical escalations, and keep customers and pod partners clearly informed through resolution.
• Support the Executive Sponsor Program – identify accounts that would benefit from an executive pairing, facilitate introductions, coordinate sponsor cadence calls and brief Mimecast sponsors ahead of engagements.
Work with data, tools and AI
• Use customer data and health signals to prioritize where to focus and to make every value conversation evidence based.
• Leverage AI-guided insights and next-best-action recommendations to work in a way that is tactical, methodical, impactful and scalable across your whole portfolio.
What You’ll Bring:
Essential skills and experience
• 3–5 years of work experience in a relevant role, with at least 2–3 years managing mid-market or enterprise-level accounts, preferably in a security-focused SaaS organization.
• Working knowledge of email security architectures: Secure Email Gateways, Microsoft 365 Defender, DMARC/DKIM/SPF, email routing and hybrid mail flow.
• Familiarity with identity and access management concepts (Okta, Azure AD, SSO/SAML) and how email security integrates into SOC and SIEM/SOAR workflows.
• Experience working with multiple levels of customer stakeholders – technical admins, CISOs, C-level executives, legal and compliance teams.
• Demonstrated ability to translate complex security architecture into business-level, value-focused conversations for executive audiences without losing technical credibility.
• Experience working alongside Account Managers or Account Executives in a named account model, with clear delineation between technical/value ownership and commercial ownership.
• Ability to collaborate and plan strategically with Account and Renewals Managers to directly support gross retention, net revenue retention and expansion outcomes.
• Proficiency in customer health scoring, risk management and playbook execution; working knowledge of Salesforce for account activity and opportunity visibility.
• Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to communicate clearly across both technical and executive audiences.
• Ability to travel up to 25%.
Preferred qualifications
• Direct experience with Mimecast, Abnormal, Proofpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, or comparable email security or Human Risk Management platforms.
• Industry certifications: CompTIA Security+, CISSP (Associate or full), CEH, or vendor-specific certifications aligned to email or cloud security.
• Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to Mimecast’s key verticals: FINRA, HIPAA, FCA, GDPR, ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
• Ability to interpret API logs, review connector health and diagnose integration issues without first-level escalation.

Job title:
Functional Specialist - Wales (Welsh Speaking).
Job Description:
Our functional specialists write reports which help the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) make important decisions about a person’s health and care.
Maybe you’re a nurse right now and you’d like to move away from direct care - this role offers you the chance to not only improve your assessment skills, but also to use your knowledge and experience to make important clinical recommendations.
Or you might be an occupational therapist, physiotherapist or paramedic wanting to learn how to evaluate situations in a different way in a different setting. We’re looking for people with the compassion and experience to understand our claimants’ health conditions/disabilities and how they impact their lives.
This role is different from other healthcare professions, and that’s why we take your training and development seriously. You’ll receive comprehensive training with time set aside for self-development learning.
If you’re looking for a change, including more regular working hours, a competitive salary and are ready to expand your skills and experience, this could be the role for you.

•
Conduct functional assessments which include initial reviews, face-to-face, video or telephone assessments to evaluate how a claimant’s health condition or disability affects them for various types of benefit.

Analyse and interpret clinical information and supporting evidence.
•
Write detailed evidence-based reports to support the DWP/DfC in making informed and objective decisions - no treatment or diagnosis required.

Use IT systems to support clinical decision-making and report writing.
•
Develop your clinical knowledge and constantly learn about health conditions which are less familiar to you.

•

Working at Bank of America Chester offers a far-reaching global career for a world-renowned organisation, whilst being ideally situated against the backdrop of the rolling North Wales hills and the banks of the serene River Dee.
Role Description:
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Security Detection & Response Analyst (SDR II) to join the GIS Monitoring and Triage team. This role supports cybersecurity operations across threat detection, investigation, response, and continuous service improvement.
You should be an experienced security practitioner capable of operating within the end-to-end detection and response lifecycle (detect → investigate → respond → improve), combining broad analytical capability with an engineering mindset to rapidly identify, investigate, and contain threats. The analyst will operate across multiple security domains, validating detections, investigating threats, and executing response actions with sound judgment.
This role requires cross-domain security expertise, broad analytical and engineering capabilities, and the ability to leverage automation, orchestration, and AI-driven technologies to improve detection outcomes, reduce manual effort, and continuously enhance overall security effectiveness.
Working Pattern:
This is a full-time role (40 hours per week), with standard working hours of 7:00AM to 6:00PM 4 days per week (Sunday to Wednesday or Wednesday to Saturday) to align with the nature of the support provided by the team. Flexibility may occasionally be required to support business, operational, or project deliverables.
Responsibilities:
• You will operate within the end-to-end detection and response lifecycle (detect → investigate → respond → improve), including analysing logs and telemetry from multiple sources to establish attack scope, impact, and root cause
• You will build, validate, tune, and optimize detection logic and coverage, leveraging attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to improve accuracy and reduce false positives
• Execute and coordinate security event response activities, including containment, isolation, escalation, and remediation, applying sound judgment during active engagements
• You will maintain and improve automation and orchestration capabilities, including SOAR workflows, automated playbooks, scripted response actions, and AI-driven enhancements to reduce manual effort and improve detection and response outcomes. Accountable for measurable improvements in MTTR, detection quality, and signal-to-noise ratio
• You will document and communicate security event findings, including timelines and lessons learned, while providing clear updates to stakeholders and driving continuous improvement in detection and response processes
• Identify gaps in monitoring and detection coverage, contributing to operational maturity through continuous improvement initiatives, metrics, and enhancements to detection, response, and automation capabilities
• Support integration of partner use cases into detection and monitoring workflows
• Guide and instruct junior members of the team to support the achievement of professional goals
What we are looking for:
• Experience in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or related cybersecurity functions within a production environment
• Experience in security detection, investigation, and response across multiple domains, with the ability to pivot across data sources and independently manage end-to-end investigations from initial triage through post-incident improvement
• Ability to build, validate, and tune detections and response workflows, including reducing false positives.
• Considerable proficiency in log analysis, telemetry interpretation, and cross-system data correlation, including the ability to query, manipulate, and optimize data using KQL, SPL, SQL, or similar languages for investigative and detection use cases
• Practical experience with containment, response actions, and automation, including developing or maintaining SOAR workflows, API integrations, and scripted response actions using sound judgment
• Experience with security platforms and technologies, including SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity security, and cloud security
• Working knowledge of identity and access systems and common attack paths, including credential theft, privilege escalation, and session/token abuse
• Considerable understanding of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), including MITRE ATT&CK
• Record of improving operational effectiveness, including reducing alert noise, improving detection coverage, and decreasing mean time to detect and respond
• Great analytical, decision-making, and communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate findings, provide timely incident updates to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and operate effectively in high-pressure scenarios
• Ability to operate with minimal supervision and make risk-informed decisions quickly
Skills that will help:
• Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence at all organizational levels
• Process discipline
• Leadership competency in geographically diverse matrixed environment.
• Relevant Cyber Security Certificate
• Worked in SOC environment before
• Familiarity with Cyber Security and Information Technology.
• Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

Data modeling, particularly intermediate representations for optimizing or transforming compiler passes

Attention to detail and a focus on high-quality design

Ability to work well with others and a belief that engineering is a team sport

BS/MS in EE, CE, CS or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience

Experience with Scala/Chisel, Bluespec, or some other language/DSL for expressing configurable hardware via software

Knowledge of RISC-V architecture

Experience with Git/Github, Jira, Confluence

35 hours per week //  Half day Fridays! // 25 days holiday plus bank holidays // Pension // Success share // Plus many more flexible benefits!
About us:
Our Planning Supply Chain & Logistics Business Degree Apprentices get the unique opportunity to work across all business functions and a variety of teams, giving you the “university experience” with 3 whole years of invaluable industry experience. This degree apprenticeship will enable you to gain broad exposure to our daily operations and management of aircraft production. You’ll gain both academic knowledge and on-the-job training at our site in Broughton (North Wales) near Chester, whilst earning a full-time salary and paying ZERO fees to do so.
You will work within the following teams:
• Beluga operations;
• Programme planning;
• Procurement;
• Supplier and order book management;
• Supply chain quality management;
• Contract management;
• Project management;
• Airbus Operating System (our Lean Production team);
• Health & safety.
This exciting three year apprenticeship offers you a full degree without fee in Applied Business Management BSc (Hons) which is delivered by Swansea University with our training partners at Coleg Cambria Northop (North Wales), with day release study to complement your placement activities.
You will also work towards ILM Level 4 Diploma in Principles of Leadership and Management and ILM Level 4 Diploma in Management. You will also have the opportunity to achieve a widely recognised PRINCE2 project management qualification.
We are also believers in experiential learning too, and there are many events that take place that offer exciting opportunities to grow and develop whilst also having fun!

• Beluga operation scheduling;
• Driving sustainability throughout the supply chain;
• Planning build sequence to ensure on time delivery;
• Managing and supporting projects across the business to implement changes & improvements;
• Interacting with a global supply base to secure on time deliveries of key aircraft components;
• Working closely with operational teams, protecting production by confirming the availability of parts at the point of use;
• Manage the performance of on site service providers, ensuring that the expected level of service is maintained;
• Work to implement digital solutions across the business.

• Business BTEC Extended Diploma (18 Units) DDM
Or

• Minimum GCSE 4/C in Maths or Numeracy and English Language or equivalent

• What skills and experience do you bring?
Think about projects, hobbies, or academic subjects that have given you practical experience. This could include personal projects, academic work and extracurricular activities.

Those huge small victories
Working in our Children’s Homes means being a part of a young person’s day to day life. This means being there for the highest highs and lowest lows. Our shift leaders enable our young people to get their childhood back and create pathways to become well rounded adults – an incredibly rewarding role to have. There will be challenges along the way but there will also be the smallest moments which feel like a huge small victory!
Our homes accommodate young people with social, emotional and mental health needs, and our aim is to create the best possible outcome for the young people in our care. Our shift leaders are fulfilled by the idea of affecting even the smallest positive
changes in our young people, so we celebrate the little things.
Get out what you put in
You’ll be a part of taking care of our young people day to day, making sure things run smoothly and creating lasting memories. As a shift leader you will also make sure that the staff team are supported and the home is operating at our high standards, prepared to step up to deputise for the Team Leaders. We’re looking for someone able to relate to and build relationships with our young people. Compassionate, emotionally resilient, and supportive, you’ll also be able to provide the leadership that inspires your colleagues.
What we do for you
We know you’re going to do great things. For your hard work and commitment, we reward you with the best salary and benefits package in the care sector. With us, you’ll get to make a genuine difference to the lives of our young people – plus you’ll get:
• Salary: Base salary of £32,014 - £36,568
• Bonuses: In addition to your base salary you’ll do up to 4 sleep ins per months, these are paid at £80 per sleep (approx. £3,840 per year) and £1,400 Attendance Allowance – assuming good attendance
• Training: A full 4-week induction on our Care Academy
• Holiday: You’ll work hard at WG, so you’ll be rewarded with 7 weeks’ holiday
• Progression: If career development is your thing, most of our team leaders and managers have been promoted from within our group – plus you could join our ‘Aspire’ future managers programme
• Flexible benefits package: meaning you can increase/decrease your holiday allowance, pension and life insurance – check out our benefits here
• Wellbeing: a host of wellbeing tools and advice including employee
assistance
• Medical cover so you can claim back the cost of things like an opticians or dentist appointment and a host of high-street discounts
• Meals provided while you’re at work
• Beautiful working environments with the very best facilities – check out our homes here
• A recommend a friend scheme that offers a £1,000 bonus every time
Bring your whole-self to work
Here at Witherslack Group, we celebrate everyone’s differences as that’s what makes us the best at what we do. Our young people come from all walks of life, diverse backgrounds and with different needs – and our workforce reflects that diversity, so that our teams can engage, encourage and inspire our young people to be themselves. You don’t need experience, but there are a few things we’ll be looking for from you:
• A ‘can do’ attitude – a team player who rolls up their sleeves to help others
• We genuinely care about our young people (and each other) so honesty and empathy is a must
• The resilience to be able to deal with challenging situations
• A full UK driving licence which you’ve held for at least 12 months
• If you don’t have a Level 3 Diploma in Residential Childcare (or equivalent), we’ll pay for you to study and support you every step of the
way
You’ll start life as a RSW by joining our ‘Care Academy’ – 4 weeks of off the job training with experienced WG professionals to help you feel confident and ready to support our young people.
Join the UK’s best special education and care provider
At Witherslack Group, inclusion is part of who we are. We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, valued and that they truly belong.
As a specialist provider of education and care for children and young people with special educational needs, we understand the importance of embracing individuality and championing difference- especially when it comes to neurodiversity. We celebrate diverse perspectives, lived experiences, and the unique strengths that each person brings to our community.
We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and abilities. We are proud to be recognised as an inclusive employer and are committed to making our recruitment and workplace practices inclusive and accessible. If you need any adjustments to support you through the recruitment process or in the workplace, we’ll be there every step of the way.
